systems.system: Projet de Filets Sociaux Adaptatifs et Productifs (PFSAP)

note: Launch of a World Bank-financed programme (USD 120m, nine provinces) that identifies households through the RSU; no exchange between systems is stated.
States 37,449 pastoral households enumerated into the RSU in 13 provinces (INSEED, 24 March 2026); no exchange with another system is stated.

facts.fact: On 10 March 2026 the ANATS director-general and a WFP Africa Bureau delegation discussed interoperability between the RSU and the Registre National Biométrique des Populations so every RSU entrant is identified by the NNI, with a memorandum of agreement still to be signed.

note: INSEED and WFP briefed local authorities on 6 January 2026 before a household enrolment extending the RSU; no exchange with another system is stated.

facts.fact: The World Bank's September 2025 factsheet describes the RSU as interoperable with other systems and lists coordination with UNHCR, CNARR and ANATS and integration of refugees into the RSU among the system-strengthening work, with 25,000 secure IDs issued to refugees and 684,500 households registered in the RSU.
